title: A Bring-Up Checklist for a Real Board: Ten Cheap Checks Before the First Drive, Run Against a Fake of the Board

questions.question: Why is the bring-up written at a lower level than the Drive?
options: The Drive is too slow to test
The board has no Drive yet
Its job is to find out whether the numbers the higher level will trust are right
Lower level code is easier to write
questions.explanation: The Drive reports metres and a pose worked out from ticks and a scale. If the scale or a wire is wrong, only a test below the Drive can see it.

questions.question: The healthy fake passed how many of the checks?
options: 5 of 10, the ones that need no motion
9 of 10
0: a fake cannot pass
questions.explanation: It read 1200 ticks a metre against the 1200 documented and passed every check.

questions.question: A tick count 15 percent off read as how many ticks a metre?
options: 1200, as documented
questions.explanation: 1200 times 1.15 is 1380, and the check measured 1378. The advice is to check the wheel, the gear ratio and the decoder.

questions.question: Why does a reversed left motor fail three checks?
options: The wheel counts down for a left command and cancels the other in the scale
Three wires are wrong
The checks are run three times
The motor is weaker in reverse
questions.explanation: The checks behind the cause fail with it. One cause, three failures: direction, then sides, then scale. The first line of the report is the cause and the others follow from it.

questions.question: Why should a failed check say what to do?
options: So that the report is the same length every time
Because the board cannot fix itself
To make the fake easier to write
A line that can be acted on saves the search that a bare failure starts
questions.explanation: Swap the encoder's A and B wires is something a person can do. Direction failed sends them looking.

questions.question: Why is the direction check made before the scale check?
options: Direction is the cheapest check
A reversed motor makes the scale meaningless
The scale check needs the watchdog
Because the encoders are read in that order
questions.explanation: With one wheel counting backward the two encoders cancel, and the ticks a metre come out as nonsense.
